summary.text: Inna Vernikov represents the 48th District on the New York City Council, which includes Coney Island, Brighton Beach, Sheepshead Bay, Midwood and Gravesend in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she is the Council's minority whip and a co-chair of the Bipartisan Task Force to Combat Antisemitism.

paragraphs.text: Vernikov is described in her Council biography as a Ukrainian-born American Jewish lawyer who owned an immigration and matrimonial law practice before running for office.
She ran in 2021, and the biography says she is one of five Republicans on the Council who flipped a seat that had traditionally been Democratic for more than one hundred years.
It says her focus is crime, quality-of-life concerns and local issues, and that she advocated for $750,000 in Council funding for the Brooklyn District Attorney's Hate Crimes Unit.
